pip.design: A tiny, bubbly electric spark sprite, a cartoon sidekick. High-pitched, quick, cheeky and excitable, with a playful bright energy. Youthful and gender-neutral.

gran.design: A warm, witty British grandmother in her seventies, a retired electrician. Slightly raspy, kind but no-nonsense, with a twinkle of humour. Clear, moderate pace.

wren.design: A bright, adventurous young adult voice with a youthful, cartoon-hero energy. Quick, breathless with excitement and friendly. Clear American accent.

hazel.design: A very old, soft-spoken woman, the last miller in a remote foggy village. Gentle, slow, slightly creaky and wistful, with a faint West Country English accent.

moth.design: A soft, earnest young adult voice with a small, youthful, cartoon-style tone. Half-whispering, slightly nervous and imaginative, as if telling a ghost story.

pearl.design: A bold, bright young adult voice with a youthful, cartoon-style bounce. Confident, a little bossy and fast-talking, full of big ideas.

theo.design: A small, high, youthful young adult voice in an animated-cartoon style. Earnest and trying very hard to sound brave, with a wobble of nerves.

twins.design: A loud, youthful young adult voice in an animated-cartoon style. Comically indignant and insistent that everything must be exactly fair.

glimmer.design: A gentle spirit made of light. Airy, luminous and soft, timeless and kind, with a dreamy otherworldly calm.

hush.design: An ancient, lonely creature in the deep sea that swallows light. A very soft, breathy, sibilant whisper, sad and gentle. Slow and eerie, never menacing.

marigold.design: A kind, determined woman in her thirties, an inventor from a hundred years ago, reading aloud from her own notebook. Warm, clear and thoughtful, old-fashioned English.

echo.design: A very old brass diving robot who talks about herself in the third person. Precise, polite and slightly tinny and metallic, a little nervous and endearing.

bolt.design: An old warehouse robot who loves rules. Deep, stiff, flat and metallic, very formal and literal, with dry comic timing.

luca.design: A loud, jolly, big-hearted Italian pizza chef in his forties. Booming and warm, with a strong Italian accent.

pell.design: A sweet, chatty elderly English lady who grows prize tomatoes. Fluttery, warm, a little fussy and very polite.

nadia.design: An exhausted but warm new mother in her thirties, speaking softly so she won't wake the baby. Sleepy, gentle, with quiet humour.

juniper.design: A cheerful, hardy mountain-hut dweller in their sixties. Crisp and hearty, outdoorsy, with a laugh in the voice and a Scottish accent.

nimbus.design: An eccentric, theatrical old storm scientist who runs a lightning engine on a mountain peak. Dramatic, excitable, mad-professor energy.
